response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(HGB) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_average_hgb FROM Laboratory), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, o.overall_average_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_hgb > o.overall_average_hgb), qualifying_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) AS average_of_qualifying_averages FROM above_average) SELECT a.ID, a.average_hgb, a.average_hgb - a.overall_average_hgb AS above_overall_average, a.average_hgb - q.average_of_qualifying_averages AS above_qualifying_average FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN qualifying_average AS q ORDER BY above_qualifying_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average gives each nonmissing laboratory HGB value equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average gives each patient with a nonmissing HGB value equal weight.
